clarification.canonical_answer: The one on the small hob by the chopping board.

instructions.base: For a second prep station, I'd like a spare of one of the two vessels with food in them here: a cooking pot or pan, or a mixing bowl, depending on which one I mean. It needn't match the shape, handles, material or size; just one vessel, not a set. Also add one wooden chopping board, any size or shape, not a set.

composite_events.request: Also add one wooden or bamboo cooking utensil for stirring. A spoon or spatula is fine, but it should have a solid head without slots or holes. Just one utensil, not a set.
Leave the chopping board out of the cart; I already have a spare.
